book.name: HEBILAIOꞌ
book.title: ZUDA VETI GULIVEꞌINE GOHI MA HEBILAIOꞌ ALEVE IZESUꞌ ZUHO MINANIꞌ NETI LUHUVO NITEꞌINE VE

content: Oꞌmosoꞌmo Gipeleine Gamazi Do Vaꞌvaꞌ O-davo Gamaziꞌve Lamineꞌ Lo-limineꞌ
Gozopoꞌ nene Oꞌmosoꞌmo gamaziꞌve avotemotine lo-ngemelesa nene ato atoꞌ gameneuꞌ monovo do ato atoꞌ ogo polohetela molavo ingine avotemotine li-ngimi ngimiꞌ iꞌmi igaꞌ aniꞌ ve.

Ne neiha gamene alingeꞌ idise mene noneꞌ gamenela nene Oꞌmosoꞌmo gamaziꞌve nene leliꞌ lo-lemelesa eiꞌ gipele neve imiselavo ogo lo-limineꞌ ve. Aꞌmine gipele nene initeꞌ mataliti meꞌnibo minelive lo eleꞌmize molo eiꞌ gipeleloꞌ aꞌmine initeꞌ mataꞌ mukiꞌ nene do sotoꞌ ineꞌ ve.

Aꞌmine gipele neve Oꞌmosoꞌmi monovo danavaꞌve atoliꞌmine goloso ogo lamineꞌ neineꞌ neꞌmi gihileꞌve gehepeve mino Oꞌmosoꞌmi emeni dameni neꞌmidoꞌ lisiheꞌ gehepeve o minive ne neive. Nemuꞌ aꞌmine gipele neꞌmo eiꞌ amuzoꞌveloꞌ molo gele mino laaꞌ neineꞌ gamazi neꞌmo nene initeꞌ mataꞌ mukiꞌ nene hize eleꞌ ivo laminekovoꞌ minaaꞌ neive. Idoꞌ aza nene goloso initete apase-ledaaꞌ akaꞌve vele osuꞌ lo-ledo veleta ve Guvelesi ve naba eitotiꞌ lemo minive nenako ana hulaaꞌ ida minineꞌ ve.

Mino Oꞌmosoꞌmi gipele ve li li-daniꞌ guliveꞌve neꞌmo Oꞌmoso gelekeleꞌ i-di gonoꞌve di-daaꞌ ave angeloliti guliveꞌine nene ivileꞌ ogo mino aꞌmine votigileloꞌ lisiheꞌ ogo ngivileꞌ goloso ogo dizosa neive.
Oꞌmosoꞌmi Gipeleꞌmo Angeloꞌ Mukiꞌ nGivileꞌ Ogo Osuꞌ Lo Neingumuꞌ Lineꞌ Gamazi

Ee, Oꞌmosoꞌmo gipelemuꞌ lineꞌ gamazi nene angeloꞌ hamokumukisi ma lo-ngedamineꞌ nenako neꞌmo nene aza angeloꞌ ngivileꞌ ogo dizosa neive. Oꞌmosoꞌmo ezemuꞌ tiꞌ lo lineꞌ monoꞌ godolouꞌ gizi nizaniꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Idise naza geiꞌ maho loloꞌ ogo
neniꞌ gipeꞌne geiꞌ nene nane lo do ote-giduvoniꞌ ve.

content: Idoꞌ ma lineꞌ gizi nizaniꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Naza nene eiꞌ giduve melehine minekuvo
Eze nene neniꞌ gipeꞌne minelive.

content: Idoꞌ Oꞌmosoꞌmo ganaꞌ gipele nene misubouko imiselelesa gohi lineꞌ gamazi ma tiꞌ li gizi nizaniꞌ ve:

content.text: Oꞌmosoꞌmi angeloꞌ mukiꞌ ingine gubiꞌ izi imi opoꞌni lilizave.

content: Idoꞌ angeloꞌve ingine gelekeleꞌ i-di minaaꞌ avemuꞌ nene Oꞌmosoꞌmo gamazi tiꞌ lo lineꞌ luhuvo gizi nizaniꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Oꞌmosoꞌmo lavo
eiꞌ angeloꞌve nene hepeꞌ ngemeni dameni di otuhaaꞌ nave.
Idoꞌ lavo
aꞌmine gelekeleꞌ i-daaꞌ ave nene
oloꞌ gulumo neꞌmine ngemeni dameni di otuhaaꞌ nave.

content: Neꞌmine o neineꞌza gipelemuꞌ neve monoꞌ godolouꞌ tiꞌ lo lineꞌ:

content.text: Oꞌmosoo, gaza gizebo ogaꞌ moꞌmosikauꞌ gizebo ogo minelineꞌ nene
huko vamo minevoꞌ minevoꞌ ogo mineleseive.
Mineleseinako Guvekasi ve loloꞌ ogo minelineꞌ neꞌmi monovo nene
monovo do lisiheꞌ ogaꞌ monovo nene mineleseive.
Gaza nene monovo lisiheꞌ laminetokovoꞌ luka molo mino
goloso initeꞌ daaꞌ monovomuꞌ goseleꞌ gebelavo mehenga emaaꞌ nane.
Neꞌmine ogaꞌ naneꞌ nenako
Oꞌmoso geiꞌ Oꞌmosoka neꞌmo eveneka ngivileꞌ ogo gaza golize izo mineline lo
aꞌmine moꞌmositoꞌ nene geleꞌmize molave.

content: Idoꞌ ma nene Oꞌmosoꞌmo gipelemuꞌ Guvekasi ve lo-do tiꞌ lo lo neineꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Guvekasi ve, gaza ganaꞌ nene me misubo do sotoꞌ molanivo
amuzo molo ha neive.
Idoꞌ Okulumoꞌ nesi geiꞌ angadunuꞌ loloꞌ aineꞌ ve.
Ne neiha aꞌmine initeꞌ nene vi osuꞌ lilisasineꞌza
gaza nene minevoꞌ minevoꞌ ogo haza minaaꞌ nane.
Idoꞌ okulumoꞌ misubo nene eveneliti okoꞌnidoꞌ initeꞌ hulupovo ili
goloso igaꞌ naniꞌ neꞌmine ilisasive.
Idoꞌ aꞌmine okulumoꞌ misubo nene litehe initeꞌ di gangi milaniꞌ maꞌmino
gango moloko gosohoꞌ ha do sotoꞌ olosaba gaza neve ha minevoꞌ minevoꞌ ogo hazavoꞌ nanivo
kilisimasi nene ogo vokaꞌ vokaꞌ ogo minelineꞌ nene osuꞌ lamoloseive.

content: Idoꞌ gipelemuꞌ tiꞌ lo lineꞌ gamazi neꞌmino nene angeloꞌ hamokumukisi lo-ngemesaꞌmive:

content.text: Nezelotiꞌ geiꞌ nene nange. Aꞌne hulaaꞌ uvoda nene minezo.
Mine do vo nanivo biluvaka nete gelekeleꞌ i-gidi minilizave lo
gizengauꞌ doꞌmo leme-ngedelesuve.

content: Neꞌmine ma lo-ngedesaꞌmineꞌ nenako angeloꞌ ingine gipele neꞌminisa dizi minami ha Okulumoꞌ ngemeni damenisi Oꞌmosoꞌmi gelekeleꞌ veꞌve minikevo Oꞌmosoꞌmo do luꞌ izelesa leleꞌmize molave leliꞌ nene hize eleꞌ i-lidilizave lo ngimiselaaꞌ neive.
